definitions.explanation: The joints of the body, especially when referring to pain or stiffness felt throughout the body.

definitions.gloss: various points; here and there; throughout
definitions.explanation: Various parts or moments in something, such as points in a speech, story, or behavior.

examples.japanese: {節々|ふしぶし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{節々|ふしぶし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧。
examples.english: I caught a cold and my joints ache all over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{節々|ふしぶし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きしむ⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: As you get older, your joints start to creak.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{節々|ふしぶし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧にじんで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Dissatisfaction showed through at various points in his story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{節々|ふしぶし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
A reduplication of ⟦{節|ふし}→節：03713_fushi⟧ (joint; point). Sense 1 is very common in health-related contexts, particularly when describing flu symptoms or age-related aches. Sense 2 is used in literary or reflective contexts to describe recurring qualities noticed throughout something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {節々|ふしぶし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ (joints ache)
- {節々|ふしぶし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧ (joints hurt)
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{節々|ふしぶし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (at various points in the story)
- ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{節々|ふしぶし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (throughout one's attitude)
